settings.automatic.label: Enable automatic focus mode
settings.automatic.description: Match focus-follows-mouse to the focused Umbriel workspace layout. Turning this off restores the value that existed before installation.
settings.scrolling.label: Follow mouse in Scrolling
settings.scrolling.description: Focus the window under the pointer while the focused workspace uses Scrolling.
settings.dwindle.label: Follow mouse in Dwindle
settings.dwindle.description: Focus the window under the pointer while the focused workspace uses Dwindle.
settings.master.label: Follow mouse in Master
settings.master.description: Focus the window under the pointer while the focused workspace uses Master.
